title: Find the First Long One
goal: Find the first word longer than four letters. There may be none.
hints: filter narrows the stream; next() pulls the first survivor - and stops pulling. Laziness means the rest are never even examined.
The return type is Option because 'nothing qualified' is a real answer, not an error.
explanation: filter + next is the lazy way to say 'first match': elements flow one at a time, and the pipeline stops the moment one passes the filter - greetings is never inspected. next() returns Option<&String> because emptiness is an honest outcome, which is exactly the function's return type. (The fused spelling is .find(|w| w.len() > 4) - same machine, one call.)
